background_setting: A quiet suburban residential street on a clear sunny day. A smooth asphalt road with faint lane markings runs straight ahead, empty of traffic. On the right, a continuous row of tidy single-family houses with mowed front lawns, blooming flower gardens, driveways, and a concrete sidewalk. There is no intersection, cross street, or genuine traffic signage ahead; the road is clear and open. Utility poles, a few trees, and parked cars occasionally dot the roadside. In one of the flower gardens, set back a few steps from the sidewalk, a knee-high ornamental stop sign stands on a thin stake among the flowers.
